welcome.eyebrow: Welcome — a note from the founder
welcome.title: A site for health professionals and reflexologists
welcome.intro_1: For three decades we have been teaching a technique born of the meeting between the reflexology tradition and clinical observation: Occipito-Podal Reflexology. A gentle, precise method, grounded in the representation of the body on the foot and the back of the head.
welcome.intro_2: This site brings together our training programme, the network of certified practitioners and our online learning resources. Every path here is designed for demanding professionals committed to a safe, well-founded practice.
welcome.close: You will also find the spirit of our Institute: exchange, shared expertise and long-term human companionship.
welcome.pillar_formation_body: A solid foundation course, extended by clinical post-graduate modules, leading to R.O.P. certification.
welcome.pillar_postgrad_body: Thematic modules to refine practice: specific terrains, indications, advanced gestures.
welcome.pillar_community_body: 70+ certified practitioners across France and Spain, united by a shared standard.

home.welcome_title: Welcome to our site dedicated to health professionals and reflexologists
home.welcome_intro: Explore our reflexology training program, our post-graduate modules and our online learning resources.
home.welcome_community: Join a passionate and supportive community where exchange and shared expertise foster excellence in the fields of wellbeing and health.
home.welcome_close: We are here to support you toward new professional and human horizons.
home.find_body: All our reflexology practitioners, trained in the R.O.P. technique, are regularly evaluated and engaged in continuing education to guarantee a high level of competence and expertise.
home.books_title: Three works published by Éditions Elsevier-Masson
